title: crataegus viridis var. desertorum
intro: Crataegus viridis var. desertorum, commonly known as the Green Hawthorn Desert Form, is a variety of the Crataegus viridis plant, belonging to the Rosaceae family of flowering plants. This shrub or small tree is valued for its medicinal properties and is often used to treat cardiovascular issues, such as high blood pressure and heart failure, due to its ability to lower blood pressure and improve heart function. The health benefits of Crataegus viridis var. desertorum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include cardiotonic, vasodilatory, and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and procyanidins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
